definitions.gloss: to walk around, to walk about
definitions.explanation: To walk in various directions or to multiple places, often without a specific destination.

definitions.gloss: to go around on foot, to wander
definitions.explanation: To move around an area on foot, exploring or looking for something.

examples.english: The dog is walking around the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: The children are walking around the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}る⟦ようになった→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧。
examples.english: The baby has started toddling around.
I woke up in the middle of the night and walked around the house.

examples.english: I'm tired from walking around the city all day.

examples.english: I got lost and walked around all over the place.

notes:
{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}る is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to walk around.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk) + ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around) → to walk around

ASPECT (ている):
{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}っている indicates an ongoing action of walking around.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}る (walk around the city)
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}る (walk around here and there)
- ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}る (walk around all day)

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS WITH ～{回|まわ}る:
- ⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧: to run around
- ⟦{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る→飛び回る：04610_tobimawaru⟧: to fly around
- ⟦{動|うご}き{回|まわ}る→動き回る：04612_ugokimawaru⟧: to move around
- ⟦{見|み}{回|まわ}る→見回る：18267_mimawaru⟧: to look around, to patrol
